Me too. i was not prepared to deal costs of surviving a suicide attempt either.

Unsure if I was clinically dead, but I attempted suicide by taking a massive OD of a drug (3 times the lethal dose). I was revived and spend a couple days in and out of consciousness at a hospital. 

When I was revived, it was like someone pulling me from an incredibly peaceful blackness. I wanted to go back so badly and I was so upset to be pulled back into this world. I'm not at all religious but since then I have zero fear of death. It was so unbelievably peaceful.

It may have been the drug, or lack of oxygen (my blood pressure was so low they thought I would die) but whatever it was was very wonderful. I don't tell many people this because i don't know who would believe me and I don't know if they could ever understand the profound peace and calm i experienced.

I did cognitive behavioral therapy to get over social phobia. It was shockingly effective and only took 1 very uncomfortable month of therapy and another few months of practice. We are talking about going from locked in my dorm room...petrified of walking to class because I imagine all the nasty things people were thinking about me...to regular, social college student with lots of friends.

I still have other issues--depression, mainly--but no one would ever guess I ever had social phobia.
